_comment: Single source of truth for which model and effort each agent uses (issue #18).
scripts/models.py check: .claude/agents/<name>.md must match this file (model: and effort: frontmatter).
Every run copies model and effort from here into runs.model / runs.effort.
Temperature is not settable on current Claude models (the API rejects it), so outputs are not deterministic; runs.temperature stays NULL.
Chosen for cost: Claude Haiku 5.5 everywhere. low effort for high-volume agents, medium (Haiku's default) for the two low-volume agents that shape the codebook.

batch._comment: Final full pass through the Batch API (#44), if one is ever run. Each request sets these explicitly; the response's model field is recorded.
